_doc: Presentation (M9), client only, never affects outcomes. bowl: top-down camera (anchor = where the ball sits on screen, 0 top .. 1 bottom, when you attack up / when the opponent does; follow = camera easing per frame). pro: All-22 broadcast view from the near sideline, your team attacks to the right: visibleYards across the screen, tilt = vertical squash of the field depth, farScale = size of the far sideline relative to the near one, heightLift = how much a ball's height lifts it on screen, carrierZoom = zoom on the ball carrier after a catch, centerY = where the field's middle sits on screen (0 top .. 1 bottom), playerSize = sprite width in yards, zoomEase/follow = easing per frame. juice: screen shake (ms, intensity) on sacks / big hits / turnovers, slow motion on clutch catches (scale, ms; offline only), confetti pieces on a touchdown, popupMs = on-field pixel callouts. audio: master/music/sfx/crowd volumes 0..1, crowdSwellMs.
